<template>
  <Teleport to="body">
    <nps-floating-survey
      v-if="shouldRenderWidget && resolvedConfiguration"
      :config="resolvedConfiguration"
      :context="resolvedContext"
      :event-seed="properties.eventSeed"

      @close="handleClose"
      @dismiss="handleDismiss"
      @open="handleOpen"
      @submit="handleSubmit"
    />
  </Teleport>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, toRef } from 'vue';
import { getUserId } from '../../../local-storage/user-attribute';
import { useLocalizationStore } from '../../../ui/store/localization-store';
import npsFloatingSurvey from '../components/nps-floating-survey.vue';
import { useRuntimeNpsConfiguration } from '../composables/use-runtime-nps-configuration';
import { createRuntimeNpsResponse } from '../services/nps-api';
import type {
  NpsBackendConfigDto,
  NpsBackendResponseDto,
  NpsResponseDraft,
  NpsRuntimeContext,
} from '../types';
import type { NpsRuntimeSurveyProperties } from '../types/nps-runtime-survey-properties';
import {
  normalizeRuntimeRoleNames,
  parseRequiredPositiveInteger,
} from '../utils/nps-runtime-helpers';

const properties = withDefaults(defineProps<NpsRuntimeSurveyProperties>(), {
  accessToken: undefined,
  adminBaseUrl: undefined,
  appName: undefined,
  configuration: undefined,
  context: () => ({}),
  enabled: true,
  eventSeed: undefined,
  modalContent: '',
  plant: undefined,
  releaseVersion: undefined,
  roleName: undefined,
  shift: undefined,
  userId: undefined,
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (event: 'cancel' | 'close' | 'open'): void;
  (
    event: 'config-error' | 'dismiss-error' | 'submit-error',
    payload: unknown,
  ): void;
  (event: 'config-loaded', payload: NpsBackendConfigDto): void;
  (event: 'dismiss' | 'submit', payload: NpsResponseDraft): void;
  (
    event: 'dismiss-success' | 'submit-success',
    payload: NpsBackendResponseDto,
  ): void;
}>();

const localizationStore = useLocalizationStore();
const accessToken = computed(() => properties.accessToken?.trim() || null);
const adminBaseUrl = computed(() => properties.adminBaseUrl?.trim() ?? '');
const currentPlant = computed(() => {
  if (properties.plant !== undefined) {
    return properties.plant;
  }

  const { plant } = localizationStore;

  return typeof plant === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(plant) ? plant : undefined;
});
const currentUserId = computed(() => {
  if (properties.userId !== undefined) {
    return properties.userId;
  }

  return getUserId() ?? null;
});

const {
  matchedRoleName,
  refreshRuntimeConfiguration,
  resolvedConfiguration,
  runtimeConfiguration,
} = useRuntimeNpsConfiguration({
  accessToken,
  adminBaseUrl,
  appName: toRef(properties, 'appName'),
  configuration: toRef(properties, 'configuration'),
  currentUserId,
  enabled: toRef(properties, 'enabled'),
  modalContent: toRef(properties, 'modalContent'),
  onConfigError: (error) => {
    emit('config-error', error);
  },
  onConfigLoaded: (config) => {
    emit('config-loaded', config);
  },
  releaseVersion: toRef(properties, 'releaseVersion'),
  roleName: toRef(properties, 'roleName'),
});

const resolvedContext = computed<NpsRuntimeContext>(() => ({
  ...properties.context,
  plantId:
    properties.context.plantId ??
    (currentPlant.value === undefined ? undefined : String(currentPlant.value)),
  releaseVersion:
    properties.context.releaseVersion ??
    resolvedConfiguration.value?.releaseVersion ??
    properties.releaseVersion,
  roleId: properties.context.roleId ?? matchedRoleName.value ?? undefined,
  shift: properties.context.shift ?? properties.shift,
  userId:
    properties.context.userId ??
    (currentUserId.value === undefined
      ? undefined
      : String(currentUserId.value)),
}));

const shouldRenderWidget = computed(
  () => properties.enabled && resolvedConfiguration.value?.isActive === true,
);

/**
 * Returns the runtime config identifier used when posting a response.
 * @returns The resolved runtime configuration identifier.
 */
function resolveSubmissionConfigId(): number | undefined {
  if (runtimeConfiguration.value) {
    return runtimeConfiguration.value.npsId;
  }

  return parseRequiredPositiveInteger(resolvedConfiguration.value?.id);
}

/**
 * Returns the plant identifier that should be sent to the backend.
 * @returns The resolved numeric plant identifier.
 */
function resolveSubmissionPlant(): number | undefined {
  return parseRequiredPositiveInteger(
    resolvedContext.value.plantId ?? currentPlant.value,
  );
}

/**
 * Returns the matched role name used for runtime submission.
 * @returns The resolved role name when one is available.
 */
function resolveSubmissionRoleName(): string | undefined {
  const roleName =
    matchedRoleName.value ?? resolvedContext.value.roleId?.trim();

  return roleName || undefined;
}

/**
 * Returns all role names that should be included in the backend payload.
 * @returns The normalized role-name array for the submission payload.
 */
function resolveSubmissionRoleNames(): Array<string> {
  const configuredRoleNames = normalizeRuntimeRoleNames(properties.roleName);

  if (configuredRoleNames.length > 0) {
    return configuredRoleNames;
  }

  const roleName = resolveSubmissionRoleName();

  return roleName ? [roleName] : [];
}

/**
 * Resolves the numeric user identifier that should be posted to the backend.
 * @param payload The runtime draft being submitted.
 * @returns The resolved user identifier when available.
 */
function resolveSubmissionUserId(
  payload: NpsResponseDraft,
): number | undefined {
  return parseRequiredPositiveInteger(
    resolvedContext.value.userId ?? currentUserId.value ?? payload.userId,
  );
}

/**
 *
 */
function handleCancel(): void {
  emit('cancel');
}

/**
 *
 */
function handleClose(): void {
  emit('close');
}

/**
 *
 */
function handleOpen(): void {
  emit('open');
}

/**
 * Builds the backend response payload from the runtime draft.
 * @param payload The runtime draft emitted by the widget.
 * @returns The backend payload when all required runtime values are available.
 */
function buildBackendPayload(
  payload: NpsResponseDraft,
): NpsBackendResponseDto | undefined {
  const configId = resolveSubmissionConfigId();
  const userId = resolveSubmissionUserId(payload);
  const plant = resolveSubmissionPlant();
  const roleNames = resolveSubmissionRoleNames();

  if (
    configId === undefined ||
    userId === undefined ||
    plant === undefined ||
    roleNames.length === 0 ||
    !adminBaseUrl.value
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const responseRelease =
    resolvedContext.value.releaseVersion ??
    resolvedConfiguration.value?.releaseVersion ??
    '';

  return {
    comment: payload.comment ?? undefined,
    npsConfigId: configId,
    plant,
    responseRelease,
    responseType: payload.responseType,
    roleNames,
    score: payload.score ?? 0,
    userId,
  };
}

/**
 * Posts the runtime response to the backend service.
 * @param payload The runtime draft emitted by the widget.
 * @returns The backend payload that was successfully posted.
 */
async function postResponse(
  payload: NpsResponseDraft,
): Promise<NpsBackendResponseDto | undefined> {
  const backendPayload = buildBackendPayload(payload);

  if (!backendPayload) {
    return undefined;
  }

  await createRuntimeNpsResponse({
    accessToken: accessToken.value ?? undefined,
    adminBaseUrl: adminBaseUrl.value,
    payload: backendPayload,
  });

  try {
    await refreshRuntimeConfiguration();
  } catch {}

  return backendPayload;
}

/**
 * Handles a dismissal event and forwards the result to parent listeners.
 * @param payload The dismissal draft emitted by the widget.
 */
async function handleDismiss(payload: NpsResponseDraft): Promise<void> {
  emit('dismiss', payload);

  try {
    const backendPayload = await postResponse(payload);

    if (!backendPayload) {
      emit(
        'dismiss-error',
        new Error('NPS dismissal is missing required runtime data.'),
      );
      return;
    }

    emit('dismiss-success', backendPayload);
  } catch (error) {
    emit('dismiss-error', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Handles a submit event and forwards the result to parent listeners.
 * @param payload The submission draft emitted by the widget.
 */
async function handleSubmit(payload: NpsResponseDraft): Promise<void> {
  emit('submit', payload);

  try {
    const backendPayload = await postResponse(payload);

    if (!backendPayload) {
      emit(
        'submit-error',
        new Error('NPS submission is missing required runtime data.'),
      );
      return;
    }

    emit('submit-success', backendPayload);
  } catch (error) {
    emit('submit-error', error);
  }
}
</script>
export { useNpsWidgetState } from '../../modules/Nps/composables/use-nps-widget-state';

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useQuasar } from 'quasar';
import { computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';

import { showToast } from '../../plugins/toast/toast';
import { MenuList } from '../types/menu-list';
import { findValidationStatus } from '../utils/screen-validation';

const properties = defineProps({
  enabled: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: true,
  },
  appName: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  menuItems: {
    type: Array,
    default: () => [],
  },
  routePath: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  availableLanguages: {
    type: Array,
    default: () => [],
  },
  sessionKey: {
    type: String,
    default: 'mesx:validation-toast:shown',
  },
  timeoutSeconds: {
    type: Number,
    default: null,
  },
  title: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  message: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  group: {
    type: String,
    default: 'mesx-validation-in-progress',
  },
});
const $q = useQuasar();

let translate: ((key: string) => string) | undefined;
try {
  const { t } = useI18n({ useScope: 'global' });
  translate = t;
} catch {
  // I18n is optional; fall back to hard-coded English defaults
}

const effectiveTitle = computed(() =>
  properties.title
    ? properties.title
    : (translate?.('VALIDATION_TOAST_TITLE') ??
      'Testing & Validation in Progress'),
);

const effectiveMessage = computed(() =>
  properties.message
    ? properties.message
    : (translate?.('VALIDATION_TOAST_MESSAGE') ??
      'This page is currently under testing and pending validation. We are collecting feedback to improve the user experience and functionality.'),
);
const effectiveCountdownLabel = computed(
  () =>
    translate?.('VALIDATION_TOAST_COUNTDOWN_LABEL') ??
    'This message will disappear in {seconds} seconds.',
);

const safeSessionStorage = () => {
  try {
    return globalThis.sessionStorage;
  } catch {}
};

const shouldShowOncePerSession = (sessionKey: string) => {
  const storage = safeSessionStorage();
  if (!storage) return true;

  if (storage.getItem(sessionKey) === '1') return false;
  storage.setItem(sessionKey, '1');
  return true;
};

watch(
  () => [properties.enabled, properties.appName, properties.menuItems],
  () => {
    if (!properties.enabled) return;
    if (!$q?.notify) return;

    const appName = String(properties.appName || '').trim();
    if (!appName) return;

    if (
      !Array.isArray(properties.menuItems) ||
      properties.menuItems.length === 0
    )
      return;

    const validation = findValidationStatus(
      properties.menuItems as Array<MenuList>,
      appName,
      properties.routePath,
      properties.availableLanguages as Array<string>,
    );
    if (validation?.isValidated) return;

    const appSpecificSessionKey = `${properties.sessionKey}:${appName}`;
    if (!shouldShowOncePerSession(appSpecificSessionKey)) return;

    showToast($q, {
      icon: 'error',
      timeoutSeconds: properties.timeoutSeconds,
      title: effectiveTitle.value,
      message: effectiveMessage.value,
      group: properties.group,
      countdownLabel: effectiveCountdownLabel.value,
    });
  },
  { immediate: true, deep: true },
);
</script>

  NpsBackendConfigDto,

  packageName: '@mesx/common-ui-lib'
  org: 'https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/'
  project: 'MES_X.0'

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

jobs:

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stage 1: Resolve version (single job, runs first)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
- job: resolve_version
  displayName: 'Resolve Target Version'
  steps:
  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: .npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate npm Registry

  - script: |
      set -euo pipefail

      REQUESTED="${{ parameters.version }}"

      if [ -z "$REQUESTED" ]; then
        echo "Resolving latest version from registry..."
        for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
          VERSION=$(npm view "$(packageName)" version 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          [ -n "$VERSION" ] && break
          echo "  Retry $i..."
          sleep 10
        done
      else
        VERSION="$REQUESTED"
      fi

      if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
        echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Could not resolve version"
        exit 1
      fi

      echo "Target version: $VERSION"
      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=targetVersion;isOutput=true]$VERSION"
    name: version_step
    displayName: Resolve Version

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stage 2: One parallel job per selected repo
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
- ${{ each repo in parameters.repos }}:
  - job: update_${{ replace(repo, '-', '_') }}
    displayName: 'Update ${{ repo }}'
    dependsOn: resolve_version
    timeoutInMinutes: 15
    variables:
      targetVersion: $[ dependencies.resolve_version.outputs['version_step.targetVersion'] ]
    steps:
    # Use built-in checkout instead of manual git clone.
    # This respects resources.repositories declarations and works
    # within job authorization scope restrictions.
    - checkout: ${{ repo }}
      persistCredentials: true

    - script: |
        echo '@mesx:registry=https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_packaging/mesx-artifacts/npm/registry/' > $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/.npmrc
        echo 'always-auth=true' >> $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/.npmrc
      displayName: Create .npmrc

    - task: npmAuthenticate@0
      inputs:
        workingFile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/.npmrc
      displayName: Authenticate npm Registry

    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: 'Update & PR'
      inputs:
        targetType: inline
        workingDirectory: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)
        script: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

          $repo        = "${{ repo }}"
          $orgUrl      = "$(org)"
          $project     = "$(project)"
          $packageName = "$(packageName)"
          $version     = "$(targetVersion)"

          $headers = @{
            "Content-Type"  = "application/json"
            "Authorization" = "Bearer $env:SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN"
          }

          $branchPrefix = "deps/common-ui-lib-update"

          Write-Host "========================================"
          Write-Host " Processing: $repo"
          Write-Host " Target version: $version"
          Write-Host "========================================"

          # ── Check current version ──────────────────────────────
          $currentRaw = (node -p "
            const pkg = require('./package.json');
            const deps = { ...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies };
            deps['$packageName'] || 'not-found';
          ").Trim()
          $current = $currentRaw -replace '[\^~>=<]', ''

          Write-Host "  Current: $current -> Target: $version"

          if ($current -eq $version) {
            Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Already up to date — skipping"
            Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
            exit 0
          }

          if ($current -eq "not-found") {
            Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Package not found in dependencies — skipping"
            Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
            exit 0
          }

          # ── Check if branch/PR already exists ──────────────────
          $branchName = "$branchPrefix/v$version"
          $branchExists = git ls-remote --heads origin $branchName 2>$null
          if ($branchExists) {
            Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Branch $branchName already exists — PR pending"
            Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
            exit 0
          }

          # ── Create branch ──────────────────────────────────────
          git config user.email "azure-pipelines@faurecia.com"
          git config user.name "Azure Pipelines"
          git checkout -b $branchName

          # ── Update package ─────────────────────────────────────
          Write-Host "  Updating $packageName to $version..."
          npm install "${packageName}@${version}" --save --save-prefix='^' 2>&1 | Out-Null

          # ── Validate: build ────────────────────────────────────
          Write-Host "  Installing dependencies..."
          npm install 2>&1 | Out-Null

          Write-Host "  Building..."
          $buildOutput = npm run build 2>&1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host $buildOutput
            Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Build FAILED for $repo"
            exit 1
          }

          # ── Commit & push ──────────────────────────────────────
          # persistCredentials: true on checkout configures git credential helper
          git add package.json package-lock.json 2>$null
          git add npm-shrinkwrap.json 2>$null
          git commit -m "chore(deps): update $packageName to v$version" 2>&1 | Out-Null
          git push origin $branchName 2>&1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Push failed for $repo"
            exit 1
          }

          # ── Create PR ──────────────────────────────────────────
          $prBody = @{
            sourceRefName = "refs/heads/$branchName"
            targetRefName = "refs/heads/main"
            title         = "chore(deps): update $packageName to v$version"
            description   = "Automated update of ``$packageName`` from ``$current`` to ``$version``.`nBuild validated. Review and merge when ready."
            labels        = @(@{ name = "dependencies" }, @{ name = "automated" })
          } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

          $prUri = "${orgUrl}${project}/_apis/git/repositories/${repo}/pullrequests?api-version=7.1"
          $pr = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $prUri -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body $prBody
          Write-Host "  PR #$($pr.pullRequestId) created successfully"
      env:
        SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN: $(System.AccessToken)
